name: Acetorphine
summary: Acetorphine is a potent opioid analgesic, up to 8700 times stronger than morphine by weight. It is a derivative of the more well-known opioid etorphine, which is used as a very potent veterinary painkiller and anesthetic medication, primarily for the sedation of large animals such as elephants, giraffes and rhinos.

uses.text: It is a derivative of the more well-known opioid etorphine, which is used as a very potent veterinary painkiller and anesthetic medication, primarily for the sedation of large animals such as elephants, giraffes and rhinos. Acetorphine was developed for the same purpose as etorphine itself, namely as a strong tranquilizer for use in immobilizing large animals in veterinary medicine.

summaryZh: 醋托啡是一種鎮痛劑藥物，其藥效大概等於同質量嗎啡的8700倍。

pharmacology.en: It is a very potent agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, the main target of opioid painkillers, which relieves pain but also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它是μ鴉片受體效力極強的促效劑，而μ受體是鴉片類止痛藥的主要作用目標；它能止痛，也會使呼吸變慢。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是μ鸦片受体效力极强的促效剂，而μ受体是鸦片类止痛药的主要作用目标；它能止痛，也会使呼吸变慢。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is an extremely potent opioid. Opioids cause drowsiness, nausea, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils, and at this potency they can stop breathing, so overdose can quickly be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是效力極強的鴉片類藥物。鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小，而在這種效力下可能使呼吸停止，因此過量可能迅速致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是效力极强的鸦片类药物。鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小，而在这种效力下可能使呼吸停止，因此过量可能迅速致命。

fact.en: It comes from the oripavine series found by K.W. Bentley, the same work that gave etorphine, which is used in darts to immobilise elephants and rhinoceroses.
fact.zh: 它出自K.W. Bentley發現的東罷因系列，而同一系列研究也產生了埃托啡，後者被用於麻醉針以制伏大象與犀牛。
fact.zhHans: 它出自K.W. Bentley发现的东罢因系列，而同一系列研究也产生了埃托啡，后者被用于麻醉针以制伏大象与犀牛。
